samples.summary: New empty-segment rejection in `seg()` fires on the *unconfigured workspace* path that `resolveConfig` deliberately produces, breaking every command — including offline `--dry-run` previews
samples.evidence: `resolveConfig` returns `workspace: ''` whenever no `--workspace`, `WAFFLEBASE_WORKSPACE`, session `activeWorkspace` or profile workspace is present — packages/cli/src/config/config.ts:100, :126, :147 and :163 (step 4 is even commented "Nothing available … commands will fail"). Every consumer now routes through `apiV1Base()` → `seg('')`, which throws. Two out-of-diff consequences: (a) the live path that previously produced `/api/v1/workspaces//documents` and a server 404 envelope (documented at packages/cli/src/config/config.ts:108 and packages/cli/test/config.test.ts:102) now dies with `Invalid identifier "": a URL path segment cannot be empty…`, which tells a user nothing about logging in or setting `--workspace`; (b) `printDryRun` (packages/cli/src/client/dry-run.ts:19) also goes through `apiV1Base`, so `wafflebase docs get d1 --dry-run` — a purely offline preview that every skill doc tells agents to run first (packages/cli/skills/docs-manage.md:59) — now throws instead of printing a preview when the user has not logged in yet. No call site supplies a fallback workspace.

samples.summary: Four preview paths bypass the new URL builders entirely, so the "preview is the request" invariant url.ts asserts does not hold for them
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/files/upload.ts:171-190 prints `{ method:'POST', path:'/files' }` without ever calling `seg()`/`apiV1Base()`; the import previews do the same for the base (packages/cli/src/docs/import.ts:158, packages/cli/src/notes/import.ts:150, packages/cli/src/slides/import.ts:185 — they `seg()` the doc id but never the workspace). Consequence of this delta: with `--workspace ..` (or an unset workspace) these commands print a successful preview while the live run now throws from `apiV1Base`, i.e. the preview describes a request that can no longer be sent. The fix belongs on these callers (route their preview through the shared builders, or at least validate the config workspace before printing).

samples.summary: Identifier rejection lands inside `HttpClient`, i.e. after the destructive `--replace` confirmation prompt and full file parse
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/docs/import.ts:120-165 (and the mirrored packages/cli/src/notes/import.ts, packages/cli/src/slides/import.ts) prompts the user with `This will replace content of ..` , reads and parses the whole .docx/.pptx, and only then calls `client.putDocContent(replace, doc)` where the new `seg()` guard throws. The guard is correct but is enforced at the latest possible point, so an invalid `--replace` id costs an interactive confirmation and a full parse before failing; validating `replace` where it enters the runner would keep the failure adjacent to the input.

verdict.reason: The finding's facts check out exactly as described. seg() throws on the empty string (packages/cli/src/client/url.ts:33-39), and both apiV1Base (url.ts:50) and apiKeysUrl (url.ts:61) pass config.workspace through it with no precondition. resolveConfig returns workspace: '' in all four branches when no --workspace / WAFFLEBASE_WORKSPACE / session activeWorkspace / profile workspace exists (config/config.ts:100, :126, :147, :164), and the step-4 branch (:152-166) is the ordinary not-logged-in state. I grepped the whole CLI source for any workspace-presence guard (requireWorkspace, !config.workspace, workspace === '') and found none; getConfig/getClient (commands/root.ts:29-40) pass the resolved config straight through and --workspace is a plain optional flag (root.ts:66). So the new rejection is reachable from every command, including the purely offline preview path: printDryRun builds its URL via apiV1Base (client/dry-run.ts:18) and is called before the command's own try/catch at commands/docs.ts:127, so `docs get d1 --dry-run` throws instead of printing a preview for a user who has not logged in — a workflow the skills docs tell agents to run first (skills/docs-manage.md:56-61). The repo itself documents the prior contract as building `/api/v1/workspaces//documents` and getting a server 404 (config/config.ts:105-110, test/config.test.ts:99-103), confirming the behaviour change to an exported symbol whose out-of-diff consumers were not updated. No refutation ground applies: the code is present as described, no guard makes it unreachable, and "changed contract with unupdated callers / behaviour change to an exported symbol" is in-lane and major for this lens.
